dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you tell me when your symptoms first started and how severe the headache is on a scale of 1 to 10?

It all started quite suddenly about three days ago, right after I had some ice cream. My head is throbbing pretty badly, so I’d probably rate the pain around a 7 or 8. I just feel so incredibly tired and weak, and I haven't had any appetite at all.

Have you noticed any stiffness in your neck or sensitivity to light? Also, are you experiencing any muscle aches or have you noticed a change in your baby's movements?
